They discussed operational systems, particularly the effectiveness of LinkedIn outreach over email campaigns and introduced CRM platforms used by both parties. They established communication channels for ongoing interactions and agreed on action items to facilitate a smooth onboarding process, including attending team meetings and setting up follow-up discussions.
